title: Negative prefixes
summary: un-, in-, im-, il-, ir-, dis-, mis-, de-, non-

rules.rule: **un-** is the most common: *unhappy, unbelievable, unfair, unusual*.
**in-** with many Latin words; **im-** before *m, p, b*; **il-** before *l*; **ir-** before *r*: *incorrect, impossible, illegal, irregular*.
**dis-** = not / the opposite: *disagree, dislike, dishonest*. **mis-** = wrongly: *misunderstand, misspell*.
**de-** = remove / reverse: *defrost, decode*. **non-** = not: *non-stop, non-smoker*. **a- / ab-**: *abnormal*. **anti-** = against: *antivirus*.

questions.text: It is ... (not possible) to do that.
